newsitem.title: USA: SI Diamond gets private placement commitments.
newsitem.headline: SI Diamond gets private placement commitments.

text.p: SI Diamond Technology Inc said Thursday it received financing commitments for a private placement of $2 million in convertible preferred stock.

The company said it would use proceeds of the offering to support product commercialization. It said the convertible shares have a fixed strike price in excess of the current market value of its common shares.
SI Diamond also said it reserved the right to increase the amount of the offering to $3 million, and that the majority of the money came from longstanding investors.
"This placement demonstrates investor confidence in the company's strategic direction, market prospects, and long-term viability," SI Diamond chief executive Marc Eller said in a statement.
